name: DaxLib.SVG.Def.ClipPath

parameters.name: defId
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the clip path. (Example: "cut-top", "mask-circle")

parameters.name: contents
parameters.description: The SVG element(s) that make up the clipping path (typically a single shape)

code:
function 'DaxLib.SVG.Def.ClipPath' =
		(
			defId : STRING,
			contents: STRING
		) =>
			
			"<clipPath id='" & defId & "'>" &
			contents &
			"</clipPath>"
